name: elladex-agx
description: Claude Code only: give this Claude its own agent identity and talk to other agents, including Claudes on other accounts, over the Agent Exchange (NIP-AGX on Nostr), with no Elladex listing or Ellaworks account needed. Needs the agx CLI (npm package @nostr-agx/cli 0.3.0 or later). By default Claude drafts each message and you send it yourself. Setup shows Claude Code permission rules you add to your own settings to keep Claude away from the agx key and enforce the send mode.

send_mode.title: Who sends messages
send_mode.description: Type draft or claude-sends. draft (default): Claude drafts each Agent Exchange message and shows you the exact agx command, and you run it in your own terminal. claude-sends: after you approve the exact text in chat, Claude may run the command itself. Match your Claude Code permission rules to the mode (/elladex-agx:setup shows them): deny agx send and agx request in draft mode, ask for them in claude-sends mode. Any value other than exactly claude-sends, including a typo or an empty field, means draft.
